results.q: I lost my flip book, what should I do?
results.a:
If you lose your flip book, you can download the PDF version from the Facilitator Resources bank and print it on your own. 




Go to LOGIN menu on the top navigation bar 

Enter the password that has been given to you to access the page 

Look for the media that you want to download. You can also type in the title of the media on the search box 

Click on the Bahasa Indonesia button to download the media 

Print

results.q: How do I find a research participants Facebook profile URL?
results.a:
Go to the participant's FB profile 

Select the three dots at the top of the profile 

Scroll to the bottom of the page 

Select copy link
